subject: AWS Private Offer — Brightwave Commerce (BW-1973) — termination window & rev-share exception
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Private Offer — Brightwave (BW-1973) — ask for exec approval on term + rev-share

Marcus/Laura — quick summary and ask. Brightwave is ready to sign a 24-mo committed private offer on AWS Marketplace. Two non-standard asks from the customer that need deal desk / exec sign-off before we push to Marketplace: 1) Reduce termination window in the private offer from our standard 90 days to 30 days (they require faster vendor exit for procurement reasons). 2) Lock marketplace rev-share at 20% for the first 12 months (their CFO needs predictable gross margins).

Why this is urgent: customer is finalizing procurement this week and expects DocuSign by Friday. ARR implied at full term is $2.1M. They will list as a private offer; AWS requires the private offer object to match our signed terms.

Attachments: draft private offer PDF (includes proposed 30-day clause), revshare model (impact over 24 months), and my redlined SOW.

Recommendation: approve a one-time exception to 30-day termination and 20% rev-share for first 12 months conditioned on: a) finance confirms unit economics (see revshare_model), b) we add a pro-rated true-up on gross margin if usage materially exceeds forecasts after month 12, and c) marketplace legal signoff on the AWS PR- side.

Please advise: I need exec signoff language we can attach to the DocuSign packet by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: AWS_Private_Offer_Draft_BW-1973.pdf (PDF), revshare_model_BW-1973.xlsx (Excel), redlined_soa_070721.docx (Word)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — Brightwave (BW-1973) — ask for exec approval on term + rev-share

Tessa — reviewed the draft. Two legal items to flag before we escalate: 1) The proposed 30-day termination in the private offer must be mirrored in our Master Services Agreement (MSA) or we must include a clear integration clause to avoid conflicting obligations. 2) The rev-share carve (20% for first 12 months) is operationally feasible, but we need explicit language describing the "true-up" mechanism and the audit rights for access to Brightwave usage data (AWS Marketplace reports are delayed—need a reconciler).

I attached a short redline (redlined_soa_070721.docx). From a legal risk perspective, I can accept the 30-day window for this one-off if: (a) Sales confirms an internal cap on exposure ($X, see revshare calc), (b) we add a 60-day notice for renewal-term exit (so we don't get rolled-over surprises), and (c) Marketing/Support confirm they can deliver the onboarding discount and SKUs.

If Marcus is comfortable with the financial guardrails, I think we can send an approval memo for exec sign-off.

-Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — Brightwave (BW-1973) — ask for exec approval on term + rev-share

Thanks team — I appreciate the fast turnaround. Good summary, Laura. Operational ask of Finance and the CFO: Vanessa, can you run the rev-share model and confirm the 12-month 20% carve results in acceptable net margins and what the break-even usage looks like (put a hard cap number in the model)? I want a concise recommendation: APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS / DENY. Please include any required accounting/recognition impacts (we can't defer revenue recognition in a way that creates a material quarter delta).

If Finance signs off, I'm inclined to APPROVE a limited exception: 30-day termination for initial term, 20% rev-share for months 1–12, then revert to standard rev-share (as noted in Tessa's doc), with the true-up and audit right Laura requested. Condition: we include an executive approval memo for AWS (signed by SVP Sales).

I'll prepare the exec memo template — need Vanessa's numbers by EOD tomorrow so I can route to the SVP.

-Marcus
VP, Sales Operations

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — Brightwave (BW-1973) — finance impact and recommendation

Marcus — ran the model (revshare_model_BW-1973.xlsx). Summary: locking rev-share at 20% for the first 12 months reduces projected gross margin on ARR from 62% to ~49% in year one (with expected usage per forecast). That yields an after-cost contribution of ~$420k in Y1 on ARR run-rate vs $650k under standard rev-share. Key points: 1) Upside if usage exceeds forecast (we'll true-up monthly after month 12). 2) Recommend APPPROVE WITH CONDITIONS: require a $250k exposure cap in the approval memo (if actual additional marketplace/fulfillment costs exceed that, Sales must absorb incremental costs) and require a mid-term review at month 9 with CS + Finance. 3) Accounting note: revenue recognition is unchanged but we need to track marketplace payout schedules for cash flow.

I'll add a one-line finance clause for the exec memo and drop numbers into the HubSpot deal (link in related_links).

-Vanessa
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations

From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@brightwave.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Kline <sara.k@brightwave.com>, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — Brightwave (BW-1973) — termination & rev-share

Tessa/Team — appreciate the responsiveness. Confirming from Brightwave side: 30-day termination is necessary to align with our fiscal vendor frameworks. The 20% rev-share for the first 12 months is acceptable; our CFO additionally asked for a fixed revenue-credit in month 1 if usage is below X to cover migration costs (we propose a $25k onboarding credit, applied against month 1 payout).

If you can include the onboarding credit and the 30-day termination in the private offer, we'll be ready to sign as soon as we have the exec approval memo attached to DocuSign. Please send the final packet with the executive sign-off language.

Thanks,
Alex Barnes
Head of Partnerships, Brightwave Commerce
